_comment: F8 stability baseline (RFC §5.8): two vehicles at different depots, one shipment. fixed_vehicle=5000 makes the solver prefer single-vehicle plans. Shipment 7 picks up and delivers at loc 1; vehicle 1 (depot loc 0) is closer than vehicle 2 (depot loc 3). Expected: V1=[7], cost = 200(0→1)+200(1→0)+5000(fixed) = 5400. Pairs with problem-published-vehicle-stability-{unhinted,pinned} which add shipment 8 (closer to V2) — these together prove the M8 hot-path stability across re-solves.
